Question: Built-up land 80% or more
QGIS method: Select by Expression on layer 'wards': | "BuiltUp_Pct" >= 80 |  | QGIS tool: Processing > Extract by expression

Question: Vegetation index (NDVI) below 0.2
QGIS method: Select by Expression on layer 'wards': | "NDVI" < 0.2 |  | QGIS tool: Processing > Extract by expression

Question: Surface temperature 45 °C or more
QGIS method: Select by Expression on layer 'wards': | "LST_C" >= 45 |  | QGIS tool: Processing > Extract by expression

Question: Flood susceptibility score 4.5 or more
QGIS method: Select by Expression on layer 'wards': | "Flood_Score" >= 4.5 |  | QGIS tool: Processing > Extract by expression

Question: Built-up 80% or more AND NDVI below 0.2
QGIS method: Select by Expression on layer 'wards': | "BuiltUp_Pct" >= 80 AND "NDVI" < 0.2 |  | QGIS tool: Processing > Extract by expression

Question: Wards intersecting water or mangrove (1 ha or more)
QGIS method: Vector > Research Tools > Select by Location | Input: wards | Predicate: intersect | Comparison: water_bodies where Area_ha >= 1

Question: Wards within 200 m of a major road
QGIS method: Vector > Geoprocessing > Buffer | Input: major_roads (motorway, trunk, primary) | Distance: 200 m, dissolve | then Select by Location: | wards intersect the buffer

Question: Hospitals inside the highest-stress wards
QGIS method: Step 1: Select by expression |   "UCSI_Class" = 'Highest'  (23 wards) | Step 2: Select by Location |   Input: hospitals |   Predicate: are within |   Comparison: the 23 wards

Question: Nearest hospital to each highest-stress ward
QGIS method: Vector > Geoprocessing > Centroids |   (the highest-stress wards) | Vector > Data Management > |   Join attributes by nearest |   Input: ward centroids |   Join layer: hospitals, 1 neighbour | Field Dist_m = round(distance), metres

Question: Ward that contains the waterlogged APMC market
QGIS method: Vector > Research Tools > Select by Location | Input: wards | Predicate: contain | Comparison: flood_reports where |   Report_Type = 'Waterlogged site'

Question: Where hot and low-green land overlaps, ward by ward
QGIS method: Raster calculator: |   LST >= 45 AND NDVI < 0.2 | Polygonise, keep patches >= 2 ha | Vector > Geoprocessing > Intersection: |   wards with hot patches | Field calculator: $area / 10000 (ha) | Statistics by category: sum per ward
